Government Decision Number: DEN-2025 / Q.6 / Aastha-12

Circular - Ma. Hearings under the Maharashtra Zila Parishad Act 1962, the Gram Panchayat Act 1958 and the Maharashtra Zila Parishads, Zila Seva (Discipline and Appeal) Act, 1964 are conducted by the Minister / Minister of State through '/ 7 (Video Conference). During the hearing by the VC, it has been observed that the officer concerned in the case appears on 47 when not in office. As a result, they do not have access to relevant subject papers / documents. They cannot, therefore, present the information required at the time of the hearing. This is a serious matter.

Further, Ma. Care should be taken to ensure that the officers concerned are present at the Divisional Commissioner's office / Zilla Parishad office along with necessary documents / documents during the hearing to be conducted by the VC from the Minister / MoS. Also, the presence of the Deputy Chief Executive Officer (General) of the concerned Zilla Parishad is mandatory during the hearing.
The decision was made available on the Government of Maharashtra's www.maharashtra.gov.in website.
